summary: The milestone completed 12 experiments in 159.6 minutes, including 6 compute-bound experiments. The longest recorded runs were the 28.4-minute native llama.cpp three-GGUF CUDA certificate and the 27.22-minute capstone/reconciliation, while the locked task-level indicator does not identify GPU idle on compute-bound tasks. The data does not establish that any task ran at least two models concurrently or missed DualGPURunner.
bottlenecks_identified: Native llama.cpp three-GGUF CUDA offload and response-runtime certification was the longest recorded compute-bound path at 28.4 minutes; the supplied data identifies its scope but contains no phase-level timing breakdown from which to assign a narrower cause.

The V507 capstone, promotion-retirement ledger, and spec-ops reconciliation was the next-longest compute-bound path at 27.22 minutes, making closeout and reconciliation a long operational path without establishing which component dominated it.

The ARC own-observation forward-inverse transition-cycle verifier was the third compute-bound path visible in the slowest set at 21.38 minutes; its title establishes scope but the supplied data does not establish a causal timing breakdown.

The gated predictive-window KAN and Critical Task Duration synthesis-only paths took 25.9 and 22.6 minutes; their CPU-only execution is correct, and the supplied data does not isolate dependency wait time from synthesis work.

The supplied GPU report is an idle snapshot rather than a task-correlated trace, so it cannot explain utilization during the compute-bound runs; this is a measurement gap, not a finding that synthesis-only work should have used a GPU.
improvements_suggested: Add per-experiment GPU telemetry bounded by task start and end, including utilization, memory, assigned device, model count, and whether models execute concurrently.
Emit phase-level timings for model loading, CUDA offload, inference, certificate generation, ledger work, and spec-ops reconciliation so the longest paths have causal timing breakdowns.

Route tasks to DualGPURunner only when their execution manifest declares at least two models running in parallel; retain one-GPU execution for single-model tasks and CPU execution for synthesis-only tasks.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument task-correlated GPU utilization and model-concurrency telemetry.
Persist phase-level timing receipts for the CUDA certificate and capstone/reconciliation paths.
Add manifest-driven DualGPURunner selection for confirmed parallel multi-model tasks.
meta_reflection: The available data supports duration ranking but not causal attribution because it lacks phase-level timings and task-correlated GPU traces. A zero savings estimate is retained rather than inventing an unmeasured counterfactual, and future retrospectives should record model concurrency before assessing DualGPURunner engagement.
